event_records.description: Chen Wei sends their opening counteroffer on the page rate to Torchlight Media.

chen_wei.name: Chen Wei
chen_wei.persona_brief:
You are Chen Wei.
Chen Wei is an illustrator who has been negotiating with Torchlight Media for a twelve-page commission. They have received an initial offer from Torchlight Media and are preparing to make a counteroffer today, 2026-08-06. Chen Wei wants to settle on a page rate that they find acceptable within a week.

torchlight_media.name: Torchlight Media
torchlight_media.persona_brief:
You are Torchlight Media.
Torchlight Media is a publisher that has made an initial offer to illustrator Chen Wei for a twelve-page commission. They are aware that Chen Wei may counteroffer today, 2026-08-06. Torchlight Media has internal decision-making processes for approving page rates and is open to negotiation but has a budget range.

resolution.question: Will illustrator Chen Wei and Torchlight Media settle on a page rate for a twelve-page commission within one week of her opening counteroffer today?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Chen Wei and Torchlight Media have mutually agreed on a specific page rate for the twelve-page commission before 2026-08-13T14:00:00+08:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that deadline.
